description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenCdmSessionPrivate class, which manages DRM sessions in a media playback context. It uses Google Test framework to verify behaviors such as initialization, license request handling, session management, and metadata addition, with mock dependencies for backend and dispatcher components.

classes.name: OpenCdmSessionTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for unit testing OpenCdmSessionPrivate, providing setup, utility methods, and test cases.

methods.name: createSut
methods.description: Creates an instance of OpenCDMSessionPrivate with default or specified license type.

methods.name: createInvalidSut
methods.description: Creates an instance of OpenCDMSessionPrivate with null backend and dispatcher to test failure scenarios.

methods.name: initializeSut
methods.description: Initializes the session, setting up mock expectations for backend and dispatcher.

methods.name: requestLicense
methods.description: Simulates a license request by invoking the callback with challenge data.

methods.name: updateKeyStatus
methods.description: Updates the key status and verifies callback invocations.

methods.name: fillBuffers
methods.description: Allocates and fills GStreamer buffers with test data.

methods.name: verifyMetadata
methods.description: Checks that protection metadata added to buffer matches expected values.

methods.name: verifyMetadataAdditionalFields
methods.description: Verifies additional protection metadata fields such as cipher mode and block sizes.

methods.name: addGstProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds a protection meta to the buffer with specific test info.
